item.title: How to Check a Solar Company's ABN Before You Sign
item.description: Every homeowner who is halfway switched on now runs a check on the business before they sign a solar contract. They punch the ABN into a government site, they look for the accreditation, and if the numbers do not line up, they walk. That is a good thing for our industry. It is also the exact check a decent operator should be running on their own subbies, their own suppliers, and the shell outfits that keep popping up in their patch.
